svg.text: Follow the red numbers ① → ⑧ to see one meal prediction from start to end; every other arrow is labelled with what it carries.
Application zone - stateless services (N instances each)
Data zone - encrypted at rest, replicated
single entry point for all users
⑦ meal, forecast, flag if at risk
One meal prediction, step by step (must take ≤ 1 s)
① The patient declares meal carbs (plus pump/announced insulin).
② The load balancer asks the IAM who the user is and which role they have.
③ Patients are forwarded only to the Patient service.
④ The Patient service reads the patient's most recent glucose readings.
⑤ It sends glucose window, carbs & insulin to Prediction service …
⑥ … which returns the glucose forecast at +30 minutes.
⑦ Meal and forecast are stored; if hyper/hypo is predicted, also a flag for the doctor.
⑧ The outcome (proceed / proceed with warning / hyper risk / hypo risk) goes back to the patient.
